official_definition: You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, at the end of battle, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Supreme Clash] or [Supreme Clash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Supreme Clash]", "give [Supreme Clash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enables direct targeting of opposing Spirit/Ultimate during attack step.
